summary: Netcapital Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its acquisition of substantially all assets of Codesharp Corporation's NetNudge AI Agent Platform. Consideration includes 600,000 shares of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock at closing, with up to 600,000 additional shares contingent on cumulative GAAP revenue of $3M or more from acquired assets by May 2029. No cash price, premium, or board advisor named. The structure involves stock-only consideration with earnout milestones; no regulatory clock mentioned. Watch for milestone achievement and shareholder dilution impact.
